name: campus-canteen
description: University Canteen Management System (React + Express + SQLite)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w client
scripts.seed: npm run build -w shared && npm run seed -w server
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
